wardley.comment: Read the lowercase wardley-beta header, leaving an adjacent statement available to its body rules. Follows detection.md#the-detectors and wardley.md#detection.

patterns.comment: Read a native YAML region from a three-dash opening fence to the first qualifying unindented closing fence. Follows wardley.md#native-padding-hidden-forms-and-eol.
Read a native ignored percent-brace region through its earliest brace-percent closer with a following whitespace or end-of-input boundary. Follows wardley.md#native-padding-hidden-forms-and-eol.
Read a native percent-pair comment up to physical line end or a separator-led common comment. Follows wardley.md#native-padding-hidden-forms-and-eol.
Read accessibility forms and the shared title value form, then the Wardley bare title with its boundary. Follows wardley.md#common-metadata-values and wardley.md#keyword-and-name-boundaries.
Read statement keywords at line, header or directive boundaries, with optional annotation number. Follows wardley.md#keyword-and-name-boundaries and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
Read the label-offset keyword after coordinates. Follows wardley.md#grammar and wardley.md#common-boundaries-in-authored-components.
Read an inertia decoration after coordinates or strategy, or inside parentheses. Follows wardley.md#grammar and wardley.md#common-boundaries-in-authored-components.
Read a source-strategy value after its parenthesis. Follows wardley.md#keyword-and-name-boundaries and wardley.md#common-boundaries-in-authored-components.
Read unsigned integer or decimal units; offset signs stay separate. Follows wardley.md#numbers.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read the separate flow opener, quoted label and arrow marker. Follows wardley.md#strings-and-link-labels and wardley.md#common-boundaries-in-authored-components.
Read a flow label without backslash escapes. Follows wardley.md#strings-and-link-labels.
Read ports and unlabeled arrows without splitting an earlier name. Follows wardley.md#strings-and-link-labels.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.arrow.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read a semicolon-delimited link label through the physical line end. Follows wardley.md#strings-and-link-labels and common.md#comment-lines.
Read a quoted name or text. Follows wardley.md#strings-and-link-labels.

Read a whole bare name, protecting internal keywords and retaining directives. Follows wardley.md#keyword-and-name-boundaries, wardley.md#common-boundaries-in-authored-components, and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
patterns.name: variable.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read coordinate and strategy brackets, separators, offset and stage operators, and pipeline block braces. Follows wardley.md#common-boundaries-in-authored-components and wardley.md#grammar.

wardley-closing-delimiter.comment: Read coordinate and strategy closing delimiters, including captures before decorations. Follows wardley.md#common-boundaries-in-authored-components.

patterns.name: keyword.operator.bracket.brackets.end.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read the square bracket ending a coordinate list, label offset or size pair. Follows wardley.md#ordered-units and wardley.md#grammar.

patterns.name: keyword.operator.bracket.parens.end.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read the parenthesis ending a source strategy or parenthesized inertia decoration. Follows wardley.md#ordered-units and wardley.md#grammar.

wardley-title-bare.comment: Read a bare title before whitespace, a percent pair or the source end, leaving glued names intact. Follows wardley.md#keyword-and-name-boundaries.

wardley-line-final-keywords.comment: Read a reserved keyword at a statement start when only padding and directives follow on its physical line. A value on a later line receives the surrounding context's scopes. Follows wardley.md#common-metadata-values and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
